title: Two-factor authentication
subtitle: Add a time-based one-time code (TOTP) from an authenticator app as a second factor at sign-in.
statusOn: MFA is enabled on your account.
scanHint: Scan this with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or any TOTP app. Can't scan? Enter the setup key below by hand.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the key and copy it manually.
currentCodeHint: MFA is already on. Enter a code from your current authenticator to authorize this change.
disableHint: Enter a current code from your authenticator to turn MFA off.
